notes_for_editor: Thin record. All three listings are hobby sites. Only the Forest Lookouts listing says where its dates come from (all three to one source, Kresek), so those dates are not independently checked. Location conflict is unresolved: the record's point (48.85216, -116.79134) is about 1.7 km from 48.83736, -116.79745, which the firelookout.org index gives (its firelookout.com listing agrees per the brief). Neither point was checked against the sources' text or a map, and the story gives no coordinates. No staffing, fire or access history in any source read, so access is left unset; 'Hike-In' is the only access statement.
